description: Issue #145, exclusion 3 of 4: 「手動テストで確認する」/ "verified by manual testing". A manual test is not a file, so no scope entry could answer the question this would otherwise raise — the run would stop on a question with no answer, which is the one stop shape a human cannot clear by editing the body. Both criteria carry 追加 / "new" plus a test noun, so removing the exclusion turns this case red.
